channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: THE BATMAN - PART II: Sebastian Stan's Role In Matt Reeves' Sequel May Have Been Confirmed
item.description: This week, we got word that Thunderbolts* star Sebastian Stan was set to join Scarlett Johansson in Matt Reeves' The Batman sequel, and his character may now have been confirmed...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailer #4 Is Now Playing In Theaters; Rumored Update On MCU's New Black Panther
item.description: The fourth Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer is now playing in theaters with Avatar: Fire and Ash, while we also have a rumoured update on plans for the MCU's new T'Challa/Black Panther.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Is "Not Anyone's Sidekick" On New Promo Posters For The Next DCU Movie
item.description: Some more promo art for DC Studios' Supergirl has been shared online, giving us another look at the DCU's Woman of Tomorrow (Milly Alcock) alongside Krypto the Superdog...

item.title: STAR WARS: Mark Hamill Reveals What J.J. Abrams Told Him When He Questioned Lack Of Luke, Han, And Leia Scenes
item.description: Luke, Han, and Leia never shared a scene in 2015's Star Wars: The Force Awakens, and Mark Hamill has revealed what filmmaker J.J. Abrams told him when he questioned that decision.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN 3 SteelBooks Reveal New Artwork Of Tobey Maguire's Web-Slinger And Topher Grace's Venom
item.description: Newly revealed SteelBooks for Spider-Man 3 showcase previously unseen artwork of Tobey Maguire's web-slinging superhero and Topher Grace's villainous Venom.

item.title: Yes, Tom Cruise Really Directed A Watery Lightsaber Battle On The Set Of Shawn Levy's STAR WARS: STARFIGHTER
item.description: This may sound like fake news, but Mission: Impossible star Tom Cruise really did step behind the camera on the set of Star Wars: Starfighter to shoot a lightsaber battle.

item.title: DC K.O.: BOSS BATTLE #1 First Look Pits Superman Against Homelander, Wonder Woman Versus Red Sonja, And More
item.description: DC Comics has shared a first look at DC K.O.: Boss Battle #1, and it features fights we never imagined seeing on the page, including Superman vs. The Boys' Homelander.

item.title: Zack Snyder Shares New Photo Of Ben Affleck As Knightmare BATMAN: "Hope Is Almost Extinct"
item.description: Zack Snyder has taken to Instagram to share another never-before-seen photo of Ben Affleck as Batman from the "Knightmare" timeline in his director's cut of Justice League...

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW Rumored To Feature A [SPOILER] Reference; WONDER WOMAN Will Appear
item.description: We have a couple of rumors relating to James Gunn's plans for his Superman follow-up here, and it sounds like Man of Tomorrow will indeed feature the DCU debut of Wonder Woman...
